inputs: plaintext ATTACKATDAWN with keyword LEMON, enciphered three ways: the mod-26 mapping of Definition 7.53, the row/column lookup of the square parsed out of the printed grid, and an evaluation of the expression string printed at hac-ch7.txt:1068
